nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: Owns the SQLAlchemy engine and session factory for chat persistence. Defines the declarative Base and a Database wrapper that creates tables, runs short transactions, and applies additive column migrations.
nodes.languageNotes: SQLite connections enable foreign keys, WAL, and a busy timeout; other engines use pool_pre_ping. init() lazily imports the ORM models so tables register before create_all.

nodes.name: db.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy ORM models for chat sessions, messages, uploaded documents, GitHub credentials, and connected repository briefs.
nodes.languageNotes: Message rows cascade-delete with their session. Primary keys are UUID strings, and timestamps default to a naive UTC value.

nodes.name: document_service.py
nodes.summary: Ingests files, URLs, and raw text by parsing, chunking, embedding, and writing a hybrid search index plus a document row. Also lists and deletes documents and re-embeds chunks when the embedding model changes.

nodes.name: github_service.py
nodes.summary: Connects a GitHub repository, indexes selected source files into the RAG store, and keeps a per-user token plus an LLM-written repository brief. Supports personal access tokens and the OAuth device flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Device-flow OAuth posts to github.com/login. File bodies are fetched from api.github.com and decoded from base64.

nodes.name: session_service.py
nodes.summary: Creates, lists, updates, and deletes chat sessions and messages in short database transactions, returning pydantic schemas so callers never hold ORM objects.

nodes.name: timeutil.py
nodes.summary: Provides a naive UTC timestamp for database defaults and parses duration strings such as 2.28s, 1m26.4s, and 120ms into seconds.

nodes.name: test_github.py
nodes.summary: Tests GitHub URL parsing, source-path selection, repository connect and delete, OAuth device flow, code-mode chat that receives the repo brief, and MCP GitHub tool exposure.

nodes.name: Base
nodes.summary: Declarative SQLAlchemy base that ORM models inherit so their tables register on one metadata object.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.summary: Creates the SQLAlchemy engine and session factory, initializes tables, migrates new nullable columns, and checks connectivity.

nodes.name: ChatSession
nodes.summary: ORM model for a chat session, storing user, title, model, and mode, with messages that cascade-delete.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: ORM model for one chat turn, including role, content, citations, feedback, and JSON metadata, keyed to a session.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: ORM model for an ingested file or URL, recording user, filename, file type, chunk count, and index time.

nodes.name: GithubCredential
nodes.summary: Per-user GitHub token row, distinguished as a personal access token or an OAuth token, and never returned to clients.

nodes.name: RepoContext
nodes.summary: ORM model for a connected repository brief, including owner, name, branch, summary text, and indexed file count.

nodes.name: IngestResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass returned after ingestion, carrying the document id, filename, file type, chunk count, and whether indexing was hybrid or lexical.

nodes.name: DocumentService
nodes.summary: Parses uploads, URLs, and text into chunks, embeds them when possible, writes the hybrid index and a document row, and reindexes after an embedding-model change.

nodes.name: GitHubError
nodes.summary: User-facing ingest error raised when a GitHub URL, token, or API response cannot be completed.

nodes.name: GitHubService
nodes.summary: Fetches a repository tree, indexes selected source files, stores the user's token, and writes or returns a repository brief for the coding assistant.

nodes.name: SessionService
nodes.summary: Persists chat sessions and messages, auto-titles new chats from the first user message, and records assistant feedback.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Builds the SQLAlchemy engine for the given URL and attaches SQLite pragmas plus a non-expiring session factory.

nodes.name: session
nodes.summary: Opens a short-lived SQLAlchemy session that commits on success, rolls back on error, and always closes.

nodes.name: _ensure_columns
nodes.summary: Adds nullable columns that exist on the ORM metadata but are missing from an already created table.

nodes.name: _uuid
nodes.summary: Returns a new UUID string used as the default primary key for session, message, document, and repo rows.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Stores the database, parser, embedder, and index, and configures the recursive text splitter from settings.

nodes.name: ingest_file
nodes.summary: Validates an upload, parses it off the event loop, and hands the extracted pages to the shared indexing path.

nodes.name: _chunk
nodes.summary: Splits page text into overlapping chunks and wraps each piece as a ChunkIn with page and order metadata.

nodes.name: _index_pages
nodes.summary: Chunks pages, embeds them, writes the hybrid index, records the document, and replaces any earlier upload with the same filename.

nodes.name: _embed
nodes.summary: Embeds chunk texts after warming the model, falling back to lexical-only indexing when embeddings fail.

nodes.name: _record_document
nodes.summary: Inserts the document row and deletes earlier rows for the same user and filename, returning those replaced ids.

nodes.name: delete_document
nodes.summary: Deletes a user's document row and, when the row existed, removes its chunks from the search index.

nodes.name: reindex
nodes.summary: Re-embeds unembedded chunks for every user, and all chunks when the stored embedding model no longer matches.

nodes.name: reindex_if_needed
nodes.summary: Startup hook that reindexes when the embedding model changed or lexical-only chunks remain, and skips quietly on failure.

nodes.name: delete_repo
nodes.summary: Deletes a connected repository row and removes the GitHub documents that were indexed under that owner and repo.

nodes.name: connect
nodes.summary: Parses a repository URL, fetches the default-branch tree, indexes selected files, and stores an LLM brief plus file count.

nodes.name: start_device_flow
nodes.summary: Starts GitHub's OAuth device flow and returns the user code, verification URL, and device code.

nodes.name: poll_device_flow
nodes.summary: Polls GitHub for the device-flow access token and stores it as an OAuth credential when sign-in completes.

nodes.name: _brief
nodes.summary: Asks the LLM for a coding-assistant summary of the indexed tree and samples, or returns a layout fallback.

nodes.name: _file_text
nodes.summary: Fetches one repository file from the GitHub contents API and decodes base64 bodies to text.

nodes.name: _get
nodes.summary: GETs the GitHub REST API with an optional bearer token and maps HTTP failures to GitHubError.

nodes.name: _upsert_context
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates the user's repository brief, branch, and indexed file count, then detaches the row.

nodes.name: parse_repo_url
nodes.summary: Extracts owner and repository name from an HTTPS or SSH GitHub URL and rejects anything else.

nodes.name: _select_paths
nodes.summary: Chooses source and manifest paths from a Git tree, skipping vendored directories, binaries, and oversized files.

nodes.name: update_session
nodes.summary: Updates a session title, model, or mode and returns the reloaded session schema, or raises when the id is missing.

nodes.name: add_message
nodes.summary: Appends a message, bumps the session timestamp, and titles a new chat from the first few words of a user message.

nodes.name: history
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent user and assistant messages for a session, oldest first, optionally dropping the latest user turn.

nodes.name: pop_last_exchange
nodes.summary: Deletes the trailing assistant reply so a turn can be regenerated, and returns the last user text.

nodes.name: get_owned_message
nodes.summary: Loads an assistant message only when it belongs to the given user, for rebuilding a download.

nodes.name: utcnow
nodes.summary: Returns the current UTC time with tzinfo removed so new rows match timestamps stored before timezone support.

nodes.name: parse_duration
nodes.summary: Parses a bare number of seconds or a combined hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds string into a float.

nodes.name: github_transport
nodes.summary: Mock HTTP transport that fakes GitHub device-flow, repository, tree, and base64 file responses for the tests.

nodes.name: test_parse_repo_url_and_path_selection
nodes.summary: Checks owner/repo parsing, rejection of non-GitHub URLs, and that path selection keeps source files while dropping vendored and binary paths.

nodes.name: test_connect_indexes_repo_and_hides_the_token
nodes.summary: Connects a sample repository, asserts indexed GitHub documents, and checks that the token is absent from API responses before delete.

nodes.name: test_connect_rejects_unknown_and_non_github_urls
nodes.summary: Expects HTTP 400 for a non-GitHub URL and HTTP 404 when the repository is missing.

nodes.name: test_oauth_device_flow
nodes.summary: Starts the device flow with a configured client id and polls until the mocked token exchange reports connected.

nodes.name: test_oauth_pending_and_unconfigured
nodes.summary: Expects HTTP 501 when OAuth is unconfigured and a pending status while GitHub has not issued a token yet.

nodes.name: test_code_chat_gets_the_repo_brief
nodes.summary: Connects a repository, streams a code-mode chat, and checks that the system prompt includes the repository brief and source path.

nodes.name: test_mcp_exposes_github_tools
nodes.summary: Asserts the MCP server exposes callable wrappers for connecting a repo, listing repos, reading context, and searching documents.

nodes.name: sessions
nodes.summary: Chat sessions keyed by user, with title, model, mode, and created/updated timestamps. Deleting a session cascades to its messages.

nodes.name: messages
nodes.summary: Chat turns belonging to a session, storing role, content, citations, thumbs feedback, and JSON metadata.

nodes.name: documents
nodes.summary: Ingested uploads, URLs, and GitHub files per user, with file type, chunk count, and index time.

nodes.name: github_credentials
nodes.summary: One GitHub token per user, marked as a personal access token or an OAuth token, with an updated timestamp.

nodes.name: repo_contexts
nodes.summary: Connected repositories for a user, including owner, name, branch, generated brief, and indexed file count.
